description: Get full metadata for a Figshare research article by its article_id (from figshare.search): description, citation, authors with ORCID IDs, tags, subject categories, license, version, publish/modified dates, and downloadable files with direct download URLs, sizes, and MIME types. Data: Figshare.com, CC-licensed research outputs, no auth required.

article_id.description: Figshare article ID (e.g. 33350571) — obtained from figshare.search results.

name: figshare.articles.details

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Figshare Article Details
